per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a NAT VPS, not an object store

chaining: A free 250GB NAT box with a dedicated IPv6 subnet; IPv4 inbound is limited to 20 forwarded ports and UDP forwarding is not stated.

limits.value: 250GB on a 150 Mbps port, period not stated
an application must pass four forum criteria: account 3 months or older, 50 or more posts, at least 25 received thanks, active recent participation

reliability_note: No SLA, best effort; instances may be reclaimed when nodes are reorganized.
